name: yokka
description: Work your Yokka board from Codex: the card work loop as a skill, plus skills for the next card, planning and board status. Connect the Yokka MCP server with `codex mcp add` first.

interface.longDescription: Claim a card, read its brief, plan a checklist, report progress, ask when blocked and complete it, the way Yokka's board expects. Needs the Yokka MCP server connected.
defaultPrompt: Pick up the next card on my Yokka board.
Plan this feature into Yokka cards.
What's happening on my Yokka board?
